description: Sets the person up to be paid for what they sell on agentPickup's marketplace, through Stripe, and returns the link to Stripe's sign-up. Give the person the link: they complete it themselves, and the assistant never handles their details. seller_type casual (the usual case) is a person selling their own things: Stripe asks only for their name, date of birth, address and bank account (sometimes photo ID), and there's no Stripe login to set up; agentPickup shows them their money afterwards (my_payouts). business is a registered business that wants its own full Stripe account and dashboard. Ask the person if it isn't clear. A listing can only go up once this is finished. Call again for a fresh link. Needs sign-in.

country.description: The country the person (or business) lives in and is paid in, as a 2-letter code (AU, US, GB, DE...). Leave it out to use where their listing is picked up.

seller_type.description: casual (default): a person selling their own things, no Stripe login. business: a registered business with its own full Stripe account.
